feature: Amounts produced by the previous effect or event
description: Add Values that read amounts and objects from earlier in the resolution or from the event: objects destroyed, sacrificed power, toughness and mana value, damage dealt, counters moved, cards shuffled, milled or drawn, blockers, and the damage dealt amount.

feature: Variable-count target slots and chosen-count value
description: Add target slots and selectors that accept an announced X, a chosen number, or any number of objects, including X-bounded mana value filters, up-to-that-many targets, announced X on abilities, per-opponent optional targets, and any-number payments.

feature: Per-player scope and chooser on effects
description: Add player routing and chooser fields so effects can target or act on another player's library, graveyard, hand or lands, make an opponent choose, exile, vote or sacrifice, reselect attacks, or hand objects to an enchanted creature's controller.

feature: Trigger events and filters that do not exist yet
description: Add trigger events and filters for cycling this card or any card, spells or abilities put on the stack, playing a card with multiple types, mutating, committing a crime, fully unlocking a Room, damage by an instant or sorcery to its target, equipped creature damage to any object, becoming targeted by your own spell or ability, discarding a card with madness, and when you cast this spell.

feature: Game-state conditions and values
description: Add conditions and values for the game's turn number, an opponent's poison counters, casting from hand, one player's untapped lands or graveyard card counts, the greatest power among graveyard creature cards, sums of two counts, treasure counts, distinct mana values in a graveyard, and a payment equal to the greatest power you control.

feature: Rule statics and permissions that do not exist yet
description: Add rule statics for attack and block restrictions (cannot attack, maximum blockers, block any number, unblockable until next turn, only your creatures unblockable, cannot block without targets), must-attack-a-named-player, graveyard targeting bans, next-spell-costs-life, equip-only cost reductions, and top-of-library look permission.

feature: Reveal/exile/mill-until loops with leftovers handling
description: Add reveal-until, exile-until, mill-and-choose, cloak and look-at-top ops with take-all filters, two-color pair choices, any-number free casts, and leftovers sent to hand, graveyard or bottom.

feature: Missing keyword mechanics (suspend, buyback, myriad, madness, foretell)
description: Add keyword mechanics and grantable keywords the schema lacks: suspend and time counters, buyback, cumulative upkeep, myriad, foretell on the card itself, madness granted by a static, unearth for typed graveyard creatures, shadow, and a flying counter.

feature: Life gained or lost this turn
description: Add conditions and values that read the life you gained or lost this turn, or an opponent lost last turn, for intervening-if clauses, counter amounts, mana value bounds and life payments.

feature: Put onto battlefield tapped and attacking or attached
description: Add counter, tapped-and-attacking, base-stat, type, color and bottom-of-library options for permanents returning from graveyard or hand, including two counter kinds and conditional counters.

feature: Delayed end-step effects on created or returned objects
description: Add delayed triggers bound to a chosen or created object: dies-this-turn triggers, return to hand at the next end step, exile when the source leaves, exile and return with haste, and phase out at end of combat.

feature: Turn-history conditions
description: Add per-turn history tracking and conditions such as attacking this turn, attacking with a Hero, permanents leaving the battlefield (Revolt), enchantments put into the graveyard, creatures that dealt damage this turn, and lands that entered this turn.

feature: Replacement effects that do not exist yet
description: Add replacement effects for draws becoming discards, destroy-and-remove-damage, losing the game, damage reflection with a draw, prevent-half damage, and redirecting token creation to the controller.

feature: Optional choices and if-you-do follow-ups
description: Add may-decline forms and follow-up effects gated on whether an optional action, discard, return, or choice actually happened, including optional returns with sacrifice fallbacks, a counter-kind choice on entering, and discard-then-effect chains.

feature: Modern keyword actions (venture, ring tempts, suspect, crime)
description: Add modern keyword actions and game-state effects: the Ring tempts you, day and night, ending the turn, controlling another player's turn, connive on a target, and turning a permanent face up.

feature: Random, guessed and hidden-information choices
description: Add die rolls and roll triggers, random selection of a creature or graveyard card, and secret votes.

feature: Cast a card from other zones with a rider
description: Add cast and play permissions from graveyards, exile or library with mana value limits, once-each-turn budgets, surveil tracking, and free casts with exile-instead riders.

feature: Selector predicates in targets and statics
description: Add selector and target kinds for shared creature types with an attached creature, keyword predicates on graveyard cards, toughness-at-most, and face-up exiled cards.

feature: Ability cost forms
description: Add cost forms and mana forms: the snow mana symbol, snow-only mana spent, announced X counter removal, and end-of-combat mana.

feature: Copy and become-a-copy effects with added types or abilities
description: Add become-a-copy and token-copy forms that add subtypes, remove the mana cost, make every other creature a copy, or combine tapped-and-attacking with a subtype change.

feature: Ability removal and base power/toughness overrides
description: Add continuous effects that outlive their source, copy the activated abilities of a dynamic set of creatures or exiled cards, and apply indefinite type or color additions.

feature: Life totals and game-result effects
description: Add effects that exchange life totals between players or with a creature's power.

feature: Stack, spell copy and spell-targeting effects
description: Add stack interaction that exiles the cast spell, links it to the permanent and lets the caster copy and cast every linked card.

feature: Ability-word label stripping rejected by the validator
description: Make the interpreter keep stripping the generic ability-word label from an already-parsed activated line when a patch is applied.

feature: one-off
description: Single cards with their own missing feature: Room door locking, a creature-only token trigger on graveyard exile, targeted goad without tap, remove-all-counters, and a mass attached-permanent move.
